{{recipe}}

'''Rice bubble cake''' is quick and easy to make. Made with crisped rice cereal, the only other ingredients are butter, sugar and honey.

==Ingredients==
*100 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] (4 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]]) [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]]
*6 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]
*4 heaped [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Honey|honey]] 
*5 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] rice [[Cookbook:Breakfast Cereal|cereal]]

==Procedure==
#Add the first three ingredients to a large [[Cookbook:Saucepan|saucepan]] (large enough to later add the rice cereal) and melt over a medium heat
#Bring the mixture to the [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]] and allow it to turn over for about 4 minutes or until the mixture starts to turn brown. Stir occasionally
#Remove from the heat and add the rice cereal. Stir well to evenly mix everything together
#Press the mixture into a lined [[Cookbook:Baking Pan|tin]] (buttered)
#Before it sets too hard, cut into even squares.
